title: Better With Bags
description: Better With Bags mod that adds wearable, placeable storage to Better Than Adventure
body:
**Backpacks for Better Than Adventure.**

Wear a backpack in the chestplate slot and your inventory gets extra rows. Hold one in your hand to open it, or put it down in the world like a chest. Each tier is crafted from the one before it, and the recipes and textures are made to fit the rest of BTA.

Works in singleplayer and on servers.

![All five backpacks placed in the world](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MinecraftLabs/better-with-bags/8.0.1/assets/backpacks_placed.png)

*All five backpacks, from the Small Leather Satchel to the Nether Explorer's Pack.*

## Backpacks

| Backpack | Slots | Bedroll slot | Movement |
|----------|-------|--------------|----------|
| Small Leather Satchel | 9 | no | normal |
| Medium Leather Backpack | 18 | no | normal |
| Large Leather Backpack | 27 | yes | up to 10% slower |
| Reinforced Traveler's Pack | 36 | yes | up to 15% slower |
| Nether Explorer's Pack | 27 | yes | normal, fireproof |

The slowdown depends on how full the backpack is. An empty backpack doesn't slow you down.

![Small Leather Satchel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/a268bb5aa42e0a04372cd8b41055945754d78cf8.png)

![Medium Leather Backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/30fc2a15af3446ea1ae8fa39e47972bfc0d7f6f1.png)

![Large Leather Backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/c9956f1320428e01cccb26115fe338c2323646b2.png)

![Reinforced Traveler's Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/455c495ac9a0605bad8b50bcf58723123f6bbf0d.png)

![Nether Explorer's Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/ab80f5254f23b5f48f8fb2d303ca8cda4d37a3e3.png)

### Wearing

Put a backpack in the chestplate slot and its slots appear under your inventory, in creative too. The backpack is drawn on your back, with the bedroll if one is attached.

![Backpack slots under the player inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MinecraftLabs/better-with-bags/8.0.1/assets/backpack_inventory.png)

*A worn Large Leather Backpack adds three rows under the inventory.*

![Player wearing a backpack, front](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MinecraftLabs/better-with-bags/8.0.1/assets/backpack_worn_front.png) ![Player wearing a backpack, back](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MinecraftLabs/better-with-bags/8.0.1/assets/backpack_worn_back.png)

### Holding

Right-click with a backpack in your hand to open it.

### Placing

Sneak and right-click a block to place the backpack. Right-click it to open it, or sneak and right-click to pick it back up. Breaking it drops the backpack with everything still inside.

### Upgrading

Craft a backpack together with the materials of the next tier to upgrade it. The contents, bedroll and name carry over.

### Bedroll

A bed you can carry. You sleep in it like in a normal bed, but it doesn't set your spawn. Like a normal bed, it explodes in the Nether. Large, Reinforced and Nether backpacks have a slot to carry one.

![Bedroll placed and attached to a backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qKHKQvPV/images/3db1bce0039fc93660c4657b6b86fce556147999.png)

### Other details

- Rename a backpack with a label and the name shows in its screen, also when it is placed.
- The sort key sorts backpack contents.
- Dropped backpacks don't despawn.
- The Nether Explorer's Pack floats up out of lava.

## Requirements

- BTA 8.0.1
- [HalpLibe](https://modrinth.com/mod/halplibe) 6.2.0+8.0.1 or newer
- [Catalyst](https://modrinth.com/mod/catalyst) Core 3.0.5 or newer, also included in Catalyst All
